Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In step 10, the WebSurfer incorrectly extracted information from the Wikipedia page. The visible text in the viewport (and the actual Wikipedia article) states that Waylon Jennings died in "Chandler, Arizona," which refers to his place of death, not his burial location. The burial location is not mentioned in the visible portion of the page, nor is "Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery" listed as the burial site in the standard biography. The agent hallucinated or misinterpreted the "Died" location as the "Burial" location and invented a specific cemetery name that does not appear in the provided text, leading to a conflicting and incorrect answer that contradicts the earlier, more reliable Find a Grave data (City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona).
